changes_made.explanation: Consolidated duplicate task entries, normalized model names to canonical forms, standardized dataset spelling, and unified output descriptions to the most comprehensive version

Removed component metrics that are part of the GREAT metric (cosine similarity, Haversine distance, weighted temporal scoring) to avoid duplication. GREAT is the main metric that incorporates these components.
No evidence of LLMs being used as judges/evaluators after generation. LLMs are used for generation (Gemini, GPT, Qwen) but not for evaluation.
No mention of human evaluation in the paper. Evaluation is conducted using automatic metrics only.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on multimodal reasoning and event extraction from images, with NLG outputs being structured JSON descriptions of events, locations, and temporal information. The evaluation is primarily automatic using their proposed GREAT metric. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization and consolidation of duplicate/redundant items.
